mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.8%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.2 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1.2M, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 104.0 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based demand expansion that forecasts higher corporate revenues and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
